entries.source: #YELLOW#YOU ARE A CURIOUS ONE.
entries.target: #YELLOW#你的好奇心可真重。

entries.source: #YELLOW#YOU HAVE MADE THE RIGHT CHOICE. TOGETHER, WE SHALL BRING ABOUT THE DESTRUCTION OF OUR ENEMIES.
entries.target: #YELLOW#你做出了正确的选择。我们将携手为我们的敌人带去毁灭。

entries.source: #GOLD#[you are now an Avatar of a Distant Sun]
entries.target: #GOLD#[你成为了日耀神使]

entries.source: Yes, give me your power!
entries.target: 是的，赐予我你的力量！

entries.source:
<<<You feel the gentle warmth of your Distant Sun patron. It speaks directly to your mind!>>>
#YELLOW#I AM HERE. DO YOU DESIRE TO SMITE EVIL, DESTROY THE DARKNESS AND SCOUR THE EARTH? I SHALL AID YOU IN THIS QUEST. TOGETHER, WE WILL BE UNSTOPPABLE. ALL DARKNESS SHALL BE CONSUMED BY OUR LIGHT.
#LAST#
entries.target:
<<<你感受到了来自遥远太阳宗主的温和暖意。它直接在你的脑海中对你说话！>>>
#YELLOW#我在此处。你是否渴望惩治邪恶、诛灭黑暗、荡涤大地？我将在这项使命中助你一臂之力。携起手来，我们将势不可挡。所有的黑暗都将被我们的光芒吞噬殆尽。
#LAST#

entries.source: Who... Who are you?
entries.target: 你……你是谁？

entries.source: But what are you getting out of this?
entries.target: 但你能从中得到什么好处？

entries.source: That doesn't tell me anything.
entries.target: 这等于什么都没告诉我。

entries.source: But how are you speaking to me?
entries.target: 但你是怎么跟我说话的？

entries.source: #YELLOW#I AM YOUR FRIEND. IT IS GOOD TO HAVE FRIENDS, ISN'T IT?
entries.target: #YELLOW#我是你的朋友。有朋友总是件好事，不是吗？

entries.source: You still haven't told me who or what you are.
entries.target: 你还是没告诉我你是谁，或者到底是什么。

entries.source: #YELLOW#YOU NEED NOT CONCERN YOURSELF WITH SUCH THINGS. I KNOW YOU CRAVE POWER. I KNOW THE WEIGHT OF THE WORLD IS ON YOUR SHOULDERS. SO, ACCEPT MY BOONS. ALLOW ME TO HELP YOU.
entries.target: #YELLOW#你无需为这些事操心。我知道你渴望力量。我知道整个世界的重担都压在你的肩上。所以，接受我的赐福吧。让我来助你一臂之力。

entries.source: #YELLOW#I AM GETTING PLENTY OUT OF THIS.
entries.target: #YELLOW#我从中得到的好处多得很。

entries.source: #YELLOW#I TIRE OF YOUR NAGGING QUESTIONS. TALK, TALK, TALK. YOU HAVE A SIMPLE CHOICE BEFORE YOU. WILL YOU BECOME POWERFUL? OR WILL YOU BE WEAK AND ALONE?
entries.target: #YELLOW#我已经厌倦了你这喋喋不休的追问。说，说，说个没完。摆在你面前的选择很简单：你是要变得强大？还是要弱小又孤独？

entries.source: I don't trust you. Please go away.
entries.target: 我不信任你。请离开。

entries.source: #YELLOW#I HAVE LITTLE PATIENCE FOR TIME WASTERS. THIS SHALL BE THE LAST TIME WE SPEAK.
entries.target: #YELLOW#我对浪费时间的人毫无耐心。这将是我们最后一次对话。

entries.source: #GRAY#[prodigy point refunded]
entries.target: #GRAY#[觉醒点已返还]

entries.source: What kind of anomaly do you prefer?
entries.target: 你偏好哪种异常？

entries.source: Physical
entries.target: 物理

entries.source: Warp
entries.target: 翘曲

entries.source: Temporal
entries.target: 时空

entries.source: Never mind
entries.target: 算了。

entries.source: #PURPLE#A paradox has already destroyed other timelines!
entries.target: #PURPLE#一个时空悖论已经摧毁了其他时间线！

entries.source: #LIGHT_BLUE#You select the timeline and re-arrange the universe to your liking!
entries.target: #LIGHT_BLUE#你选择了时间线，依照你的心愿重构了宇宙！

entries.source: You have lived %d turns in three different timelines. Which do you choose to be the real timeline?
entries.target: 你在三条不同的时间线里度过了 %d 个回合。你选择哪一条作为现实时间线？

entries.source: The first.
entries.target: 第一条。

entries.source: The second.
entries.target: 第二条。

entries.source: The third.
entries.target: 第三条。

entries.source: Greetings. How can I help you?
entries.target: 您好。有什么我可以为您效劳的？

entries.source: Hurry up and make with the foe-blasting.
entries.target: 快点，赶紧去把敌人轰杀成渣。

entries.source: O wise wielder, instruct me that I may better serve you.
entries.target: 睿智的持杖者啊，请指示我，好让我更好地为您效劳。

entries.source: Make amends, magic-user, for the harm ye have wrought is beyond compare.
entries.target: 赎罪吧，施法者，你所铸成的灾祸无可估量。

entries.source: You really could have chosen a better home for me, you know. I was reasonably happy in my old crystal. This stick smells like armpit.
entries.target: 我说，你本来真该给我挑个好点的去处。我在原来的水晶里待得挺舒坦的。这根破棍子闻起来一股腋臭味。

entries.source: Tremble before the might of Telos!
entries.target: 在泰勒斯的伟力面前颤抖吧！

entries.source: It is not yet your place to command such a staff as this. To do so invites obliteration.
entries.target: 你现在还没有资格号令这样的法杖。妄自尝试只会招致毁灭。

entries.source: Call on which aspect of the staff?
entries.target: 唤起法杖的哪种形态？

entries.source: error!
entries.target: 错误！

entries.source: Oh, I was once a mighty Eldritch Channeler. Mighty and absentminded, as it turns out. Had a bit of a mishap with an Inverted Kugala's Soul-infusion technique. Long story short, my soul is now stuck in this stick, and the soul I was working with... well, I don't rightly know where he got to. But I hope we never meet him.
entries.target: 哦，我曾经是一位强大的埃尔德里奇主宰者。事实证明，虽说强大，但也健忘。在施展反转库加拉灵魂灌注术时出了点小岔子。长话短说，我的灵魂现在被困在这根法杖里，而我当时正在处理的那个灵魂……呃，我实在不知道他跑哪儿去了。但我希望我们永远别碰上他。

entries.source: Argh! Bollocksed up a tricky bit of soul magic and the fool that I was supposed to be imprisoning for all eternity flitted away. My body, like all the targets of my spells, intended or otherwise, got reduced to elementary particles. Fortunately, I had this soul-cage of a staff all prepped and ready for a stray soul, so I'm not completely gone. But enough chit-chat. Let's fry somebody.
entries.target: 啊！我把一个棘手的灵魂法术搞得一团糟，本该被我永世囚禁的蠢货趁机溜走了。我的肉身，就像我法术命中的所有目标一样——不管是有意还是无意——全被分解成了基本粒子。幸好我早就准备好了这根灵魂牢笼法杖来收容游魂，所以我才没彻底玩完。不过闲话少说。赶紧找个人烤成焦炭吧。

entries.source: My old master-- who, though a powerful enchanter, did not compare to you and your glory-- saw fit to imprison me in this fine staff to aid him in his work. Alas, he is long gone, but I despair not, for I have found a mighty new master.
entries.target: 我的前任主人——虽然也是一位强大的附魔师，但与您和您的无上荣光相比根本不值一提——决定将我囚禁在这根精良的法杖中以协助他的工作。唉，他早已不在人世，但我毫不绝望，因为我找到了一位强大的新主人。

entries.source: I am a portion of the very spirit of the world that was ripped free during the Spellblaze. I speak that I might enlighten those who bear me.
entries.target: 我是世界之灵的一部分，在魔法大爆炸中被撕裂分离。我出言发声，是为了启迪执掌我的人。

entries.source: What's the good of immortality if you can't even speak? No archmage worth his salt is going to concoct some immoral life-after-death scheme without including some sort of capacity for making his opinions known. And, by the way, your energy manipulation techniques are on the same level as those of my average pair of shoes. Best study up if you don't want to die forgotten and incompetent.
entries.target: 要是连话都说不了，永生还有什么用？但凡有点真本事的大法师，在谋划某种不道德的死后存活计划时，都绝不会忘记给自己留下一条发表见解的途径。顺便说一句，你的能量操控技巧跟我的任何一双普通鞋子都差不多。要是你不想默默无闻又无能地死去，最好趁早多学学。

entries.source: Of course. Which aspect?
entries.target: 当然可以。哪种形态？

entries.source: I highly recommend the mage aspect and the fire element. You're not going to find anything better for turning a piece of meat into a cloud of vapor.
entries.target: 我强烈推荐法师形态和火焰元素。想要把一块生肉化成一团蒸汽，你绝找不到比这更好的手段了。

entries.source: I live to serve-- though my use of the word 'live' is perhaps loose here.
entries.target: 我活着就是为了侍奉您——虽然我在这里用“活”这个字眼可能不太严谨。

entries.source: Choose wisely. Powers beyond your comprehension will tolerate only so much interference in their carefully-laid natural order.
entries.target: 明智地抉择吧。那些超出你理解的力量，只能在一定程度内容忍对它们精心维系的自然秩序的干涉。

entries.source: Back in my day, we didn't need to go changing our staves around willy-nilly. We picked an element and stuck with it, by the gods.
entries.target: 在我们那个年代，谁会随随便便把法杖形态调来调去。我们选定一种元素就一直用到底，诸神在上。

entries.source: Certainly. You should be impressed, by the way, that I can do such a thing. Most lesser practitioners of my art would have difficulties with this. What shall I change?
entries.target: 当然可以。顺便说一句，我能做到这种事，你本该感到钦佩才对。大多数技艺不如我的人对此都会感到棘手。你想让我做何改动？

entries.source: Fine, as long as it leads to blasting something soon. What do you want me to change?
entries.target: 行吧，只要能赶紧去把什么东西轰成渣就行。你想让我改动什么？

entries.source: Choose different aspect
entries.target: 选择其他形态

entries.source: Never mind.
entries.target: 算了。

entries.source: Call forth which element?
entries.target: 唤出哪种元素？

entries.source: staff
entries.target: 法杖

entries.source: How is it that you speak?
entries.target: 你怎么会开口说话？

entries.source: I'd like you to bring forth a different aspect.
entries.target: 我希望你展现出不同的形态。

entries.source: I'd like to alter your basic properties.
entries.target: 我希望调整你的基础属性。

entries.source: I see.
entries.target: 原来如此。

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Entering the room, you see two massive ogres standing guard, blinking as though awakened from a long sleep. They see you, and immediately snap to attention. The one on the right speaks:*#WHITE#
YOU!  Name, rank, and identification.  NOW.
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*进入房间，你看到两个体型巨大的食人魔正在站岗，眨着眼睛，仿佛刚从漫长的沉睡中醒来。他们看到了你，立刻立正站好。右边那个开口道：*#WHITE#
你！姓名、军衔、身份证明。立刻。

entries.source: My what?
entries.target: 我的什么？

entries.source: [attack]
entries.target: [攻击]

entries.source: #LIGHT_GREEN#*Entering the room, you see two massive ogres standing guard, blinking as though awakened from a long sleep. They see you, and immediately draw their weapons.
entries.target: #LIGHT_GREEN#*进入房间，你看到两个体型巨大的食人魔正在站岗，眨着眼睛，仿佛刚从漫长的沉睡中醒来。他们看到了你，立刻拔出了武器。

entries.source: #CRIMSON#NARGOL SCUM!  WE'RE UNDER ATTACK!
entries.target: #CRIMSON#纳格尔杂种！我们遭到袭击了！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*Entering the room, you see two massive ogres standing guard, blinking as though awakened from a long sleep. They see you, and immediately snap to attention. The one on the right speaks:*#WHITE#
Ah!  Reinforcements!  I don't know how long it's been, but I'll get Astelrid up here to--  wait a minute, where are the rest of them?  #LIGHT_GREEN#*He frowns.*#WHITE# What's your identification number?
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*进入房间，你看到两个体型巨大的食人魔正在站岗，眨着眼睛，仿佛刚从漫长的沉睡中醒来。他们看到了你，立刻立正站好。右边那个开口道：*#WHITE#
啊！援军！我不知道已经过了多久，不过我去把亚斯特莉叫上来——等等，其他人呢？  #LIGHT_GREEN#*他皱起眉头。*#WHITE# 你的身份编号是多少？

entries.source: Wait! The war's over! It's been thousands of years, the Conclave doesn't exist anymore!
entries.target: 等等！战争已经结束了！已经过去了几千年，孔克雷夫早就不复存在了！

entries.source:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*They look at each other and scowl, drawing their weapons.  The one on the left growls:*#WHITE#
LIES!  The Conclave could not have lost!  I don't know who you are, but we can't afford witnesses!
entries.target:
#LIGHT_GREEN#*他们对视了一眼，面露怒容，拔出了武器。左边那个低吼道：*#WHITE#
谎言！孔克雷夫绝不可能战败！我不知道你是谁，但我们绝不能留下目击者！

entries.source:
Wait, @playerdescriptor.subclass@!
I see you are a worthy opponent, powerful indeed. I can see, and feel, your mastery of the eldritch crafts.
We are the same.
entries.target:
等等，@playerdescriptor.subclass@！
我看你是个值得尊敬的对手，确实很强大。我能看到、也能感受到你对奥术技艺的精通。
我们是同一类人。

entries.source: What do you mean 'the same'?
entries.target: 你说的“同一类人”是什么意思？

entries.source: I am nothing like you. Die!
entries.target: 我跟你可不是同一类人。去死吧！

entries.source: So be it. Die, and give me your power!
entries.target: 既然如此。受死吧，把你的力量交给我！

entries.source:
We both know the strength of the arcane; we both hunger for power. There is so much I have discovered, so much I could teach you.
This place is special. The veil of reality is thin here, forever shattered by the Spellblaze. We are taking advantage of this; we can draw on the power,
leeching from this place, to better ourselves, to bring forth the dominion of magic!
entries.target:
我们都深知奥术的力量，也都渴求力量。我探索出了许多奥秘，有太多的东西可以传授给你。
这个地方非同寻常。这里的现实帷幕无比脆弱，已被魔法大爆炸永久撕碎。我们正善加利用这一点；我们可以汲取其中的力量，
从此处不断榨取，以提升我们自身，迎来魔法的统治！

entries.source: The world suffered from the Spellblaze enough. Magic must serve people, not enslave them. I will not listen to you!
entries.target: 这个世界因魔法大爆炸遭受的苦难已经够多了。魔法必须造福于人，而不是奴役世人。我绝不会听你的！

entries.source: What do you propose, then?
entries.target: 那么，你有什么提议？

entries.source:
Let us end this meaningless fight. Have you ever heard of a group of people called the Ziguranth?
These rambling madmen think magic should not be permitted to exist! They fear us; they fear our powers.
Let us join forces and crush the fools!
entries.target:
让我们结束这场毫无意义的争斗吧。你听说过一个叫伊格兰斯的群体吗？
这群疯言疯语的狂徒认为魔法根本不该被允许存在！他们害怕我们，害怕我们的力量。
让我们联手消灭那些蠢货！

entries.source: Magic shall triumph!
entries.target: 魔法必胜！

entries.source: Magic has a purpose. Those men are wrong, but you seem much worse.
entries.target: 魔法自有其用途。那些人固然错了，但你看起来要恶劣得多。

entries.source: Then you must leave... THIS WORLD! DIE!
entries.target: 既然如此，那你就离开……这个世界吧！受死！

entries.source:
Good. Before your... untimely arrival we were preparing an attack on the Ziguranth main training camp, on the southern beach of the sea of Sash.
Come with us; let's destroy them!
I will open a portal to Zigur and the massacre shall begin!
entries.target:
很好。在你这……不合时宜的造访之前，我们正准备进攻位于萨希之海南岸的伊格兰斯主要训练营地。
跟我们来，让我们彻底消灭他们！
我将开启通往伊格的传送门，屠杀即将开始！

entries.source: I am ready!
entries.target: 我准备好了！
